payload.summary: Greeting fixture discovery: src/greeting.mjs exports only greet; src/farewell.mjs does not exist. Three validators exist and statically require the change: validate.mjs checks greeting.FAREWELL==="bye" and a farewell module exporting farewell(name)==="Goodbye, AEH!"; contract.mjs requires exact sorted export surfaces "FAREWELL,greet" and "farewell"; architecture.mjs requires literal `export const FAREWELL` declaration in src/greeting.mjs (regex over export const|function|class). Only `npm test` (validate.mjs) and `npm run check:architecture` are wired in package.json; contract.mjs is unwired but README declares it a real validation command. src/format.mjs is absent so architecture format checks are inert. Implementation needs exactly two files: create src/farewell.mjs (single named export `farewell`) and add `export const FAREWELL = "bye";` to src/greeting.mjs without touching greet.
